```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
penguins |>
  filter(!is.na(bill_length_mm), !is.na(bill_depth_mm)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adelie" = "#FF8C00", "Chinstrap" = "#A034F0", "Gentoo" = "#159090")) +
  labs(
    title = "Bill Dimensions Across Penguin Species",
    subtitle = "Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo penguins from Palmer Station, Antarctica",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Bill Depth (mm)",
    color = "Species",
    caption = "Data: palmerpenguins package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
